blockingFindings.title: Upgrade-unrelated gate can fail before bypassing upgrade evidence
blockingFindings.issue: `UpgradeEvidenceRecovery` validates any existing `upgrade-result.json` in the constructor before `resolve()` checks `currentRequiredPaths.length === 0`. That means an upgrade-unrelated impl-gate can throw on a malformed, failed, or stale leftover upgrade artifact instead of taking the required bypass path.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Move the existing-artifact validation behind the `currentRequiredPaths.length > 0` branch, or make the constructor skip `assertExistingArtifactIsUsableOrAbsent()` when `matchUpgradeRequiredSourcePaths(currentRequiredPaths)` is empty.
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 requires upgrade-unrelated changes to bypass upgrade evidence. The current control flow can block that bypass solely because a stale or malformed upgrade artifact exists, so this is tied to a mandatory acceptance requirement.
